idea: Back any 1X2 side SportyBet prices 3%+ above Matchbook's fair price (margin removed) at first look
result: 199 bets, hit 0.367, return +19.4% ± 14.1%; later half +28.5%, CLV +17.3%
source: backtest/MATCHBOOK_PRICE_STUDY.md (SportyBet-above-Matchbook-fair mismatches); Kaunitz, Zhong & Kreiner 2017, 'Beating the bookies with their own numbers' (arXiv:1710.02824) — a soft book's price above the sharp consensus is the edge

idea: Favourite-longshot bias: short home favourites (1.20-1.50) return more per unit than the margin implies
result: 422 bets, hit 0.725, return -1.9% ± 3.0%; later half -1.9%, CLV +0.5%
source: favourite-longshot bias in football fixed odds (Cain, Law & Peel 2000, Scottish Journal of Political Economy); backtest/PAPER_BOOK.md short-favourite rule

idea: SportyBet's closing Over 2.5 price knows something the model doesn't — lean the model's Over 2.5 toward it
source: backtest/FEATURES_STUDY.md first run (gain +0.0023 ± 0.0015, the closest to a signal); the closing line as the best public forecast (Pinnacle/Buchdahl closing-line research)
